name: iconvault-cli
description: IconVault command line, stdio MCP server, and remote HTTP MCP endpoint. Uses personal API tokens for project and icon operations.

scripts.build:standalone:win-x64: esbuild bin/iconvault-standalone.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node24 --outfile=dist/iconvault-standalone.cjs && pkg dist/iconvault-standalone.cjs --target node24-win-x64 --output dist/iconvault-mcp-win-x64.exe
